lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid across the lateral midline, with a dense grouping observable in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal planes to form a lattice; high-intensity blobs are situated at several identifiable grid-node intersections along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and shadow casting on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation is present on the trailing (posterior) edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five dark, elongated silhouettes (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
